name: copilotprompts-skill-declarative-agent-manifest-review
title: Declarative Agent Manifest Review Skill
shortDescription: A GitHub Copilot skill that reviews a Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent manifest against its schema version and separates what blocks the agent from what changes what it can read.
longDescription: A reusable GitHub Copilot skill that reviews declarativeAgent.json against the reference and JSON schema for the manifest's own version. It reports blocking findings, such as unrecognized properties, character limits, capability limits and missing package files, separately from behaviour findings, such as knowledge capabilities with no scope, conversation starters that depend on missing capabilities and instructions that name functions the manifest does not configure. It lists what it could not check without the tenant or the built package. Install it by copying the SKILL.md file into your repository's .github/skills/declarative-agent-manifest-review/ folder.
